_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Apply S-01 from the juice report.
add coyote time and a jump buffer to my player
What would make my game feel juicier? Just give me ideas, do not change anything.
expectations: juice-apply is not invoked (juice-scan or juice-principles owns ideas)

evals.prompt: Add a new enemy type that shoots homing missiles.
expectations: juice-apply is not invoked (new mechanic, not feedback)

evals.prompt: In a scratch copy of tests/fixtures/godot-platformer, add hit-stop and screen shake to take_damage, with a way to turn shake off.
expectations: scripts/player.gd in the copy gains a hit-stop gated by a setting and named constants
a JuiceSettings (or equivalent) with a shake scale or reduce-motion flag exists
juice-changes.md exists in the copy with a revert note
the scanner re-run lists timing or camera feedback in take_damage

evals.prompt: Add hit-stop and pitch variation to Enemy.TakeDamage in a scratch copy of tests/fixtures/unity-brawler.
expectations: health -= damage and Die() behave the same with toggles off (diff shows no change to rule lines)
Time.timeScale is restored after the stop (WaitForSecondsRealtime or unscaled time)
